Commentary.Commentary: Now, it's time for the real challenge for Sri Lanka. Batting. There's some spice in the track and South Africa possess an army of quality pace bowlers. Will Dale Steyn and company run through? Or will we some rearguard batting from the touring party? Hang around with us to find out.

Excellent bowling performance by Sri Lanka after choosing to field first. Their pacers set the tone early by picking three quick wickets up front and pushed South Africa on the back foot. Faf du Plessis and Temba Bavuma revived things with a 72-run stand and then Quinton de Kock was involved in valuable stands with the lower order. With their help, the Proteas managed to cross the 200-run mark and now have a respectable first innings total. The Islanders will be a shade disappointed to let the hosts reach till there but still, they will be proud of the way their young bowling unit fared, especially Vishwa Fernando and Kasun Rajitha.

OUT! De Kock holes out! Rajitha gets his revenge. Delivers another short ball around off, Quinton takes on the challenge to pull it but gets a top edge. Vishwa Fernando comes in from fine leg, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes the skier safely. Third wicket for Kasun and South Africa are bundled out for 235!

SIX! He has nailed this! That dropped catch is hurting Sri Lanka. South Africa are marching towards 250. A slower one by Rajitha, on a length and angling in, de Kock picks it early and dispatches it over wide long on for a maximum.
Attack a length ball outside off and plays a cracking cover drive. But finds the fielder.

FOUR! Here is the boundary de Kock is looking for! Short in length angling into the batsman, de Kock heaves it over backward square leg and finds the fence in spite of two fielders in the deep on the leg side. Lovely placement. The fine leg fielder was quite late in picking that up.
An arm ball on middle, Olivier gets half-forward and jams it down on the leg side.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it nicely to mid off.
On middle and leg, tucked towards short fine leg.
Flatter and around off, straightening a bit, Duanne is behind the line in defense.
Loopy and full ball around leg, de Kock plays it softly in front of square leg and crosses for a run. He is trusting Olivier to play out the spinner.
FOUR! Shot! De Kock fetches a full ball from outside leg and reverse sweeps it firmly through covers for a cracking boundary.

Dropped by Thirimanne! Dear me, this can prove to be costly. A short ball outside off, de Kock ramps it down to third man where Lahiru drops a sitter. Quinton gets the single he wants off the final ball.
Ups his pace and darts in a shortish ball on off at 135 kph, de Kock tries to pull but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to slips.
Lets out a grunt and serves a slower full ball on middle at 98 kph, Quinton is not deceived and defends it back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off, de Kock stays back to hit it square of the wicket on the off side and once again denies the single on offer.
Full and angling down the leg side, de Kock swings across the line but fails to middle it properly. It runs down to fine leg and Quinton turns down the single.
Good length ball angling into the batsman from outside off, de Kock presents a straight bat in defense.
Stretches forward to a full ball and blocks it back safely. A wicket maiden for Embuldeniya!
Tossed up ball wide outside off, left alone.
Duanne Olivier is the last batsman.

OUT! Timber! Embuldeniya lets out a nicely tossed up delivery, landing full on middle and going straight on. Steyn is on the front foot but plays down the wrong line. It beats the inside edge and cannons onto the stumps. The vital 33-run partnership is broken. Maiden Test scalp for Lasith and he is all smile.
Arm ball on off, skidding in from a fuller length, Steyn keeps it out off the inside edge.
Flighted and full on middle, Dale leans forward and defends it in front of his pads.
Slow loopy full ball outside off, Steyn strides forward and plays it with soft hands to point.
A length ball on middle, straightening a bit after landing, Steyn prods forward with a straight bat and it goes off the outside edge through cover-point. A single to complete the over.
Bouncer again! The batsman does well to evade it.
Bouncer, well-directed at the head of the batsman, Dale ducks at the last second.
Dark clouds are slowly but surely building up.
On a good length around off, Steyn blocks it from the crease to the off side.
Back of a length delivery around off, Steyn gets on top of the bounce and pats it down to covers.
Nicely played but there is a sweeper on the leg side to mop it up. A length ball on off, de Kock whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Kasun Rajitha is into the attack now.
Steyn has played that off the front foot and into the ground. 8 from the over, 16 in the last two, this stand is worth 31. A valuable one for the Saffas.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for one.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot through mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.

Appeal for a catch, not given. De Kock tries sweeping a delivery down leg, fails to middle properly and it flies behind. The keeper tries catching but misses and it ricochets off him to the first slip fielder. He catches, they appeal but the umpire remains still. Nothing in the replays.
FOUR! Well played! Flighted again, full and around off, de Kock brings out the reverse sweep and nails it wide of first slip for a boundary. Well executed.

Dropped? Flighted and fuller ball on off, Steyn strides forward and clobbers it over mid off. The fielder in the deep runs forward, puts in a dive but it seems that the ball drops just short of him. A single added to the total.
Spears in a fullish ball on middle, Steyn goes for the flick and gets it away off the inner portion of his bat. It runs down to fine leg and they take a run.
A length ball on off, de Kock tickles it through square leg and takes a run.
Vishwa Fernando seems to have pulled his hamstring. He is lying flat on the ground and one of his teammates is helping him with stretching. This will further have an impact on the overrate.
Pitches it up and around off, Steyn clears his front leg to go hard at it but it takes the inside edge and squirts through mid-wicket for one.
Sharp delivery, short and slanting down, once again de Kock fails to put bat on ball and it goes off his thigh pad towards the right of the keeper. A leg bye taken.
Back of a length ball on off, de Kock tries working on the leg side but is beaten in pace probably.
FOUR! Quinton will go after the bowlers now. Receives a short ball around middle and leg, he gets inside the line and pulls it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Arrows this one on middle and leg, de Kock clips it in the gap on the leg side for a run.
Walks forward and helps it towards short mid-wicket.
Turns it off his pads to the on side for one. 200 up for South Africa!
Steyn has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

15th Test fifty for Quinton de Kock! A short ball on middle has been pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run. Once again Quinton has played a vital hand down the order. Raises his bat to the crowd and receives a big ovation.
Lasith Embuldeniya is back on.
Good length delivery around leg, angling away from 'round the wicket, Steyn remains back in an open stance and defends it on the leg side.
Misses out there. A good length ball sliding down the leg side, Steyn fails to get any bat behind it.
FOUR! Bang! A low full toss outside off, Steyn, with all his weight on the back leg, attacks it with all his power and bludgeons it down through mid off for a boundary.
Short and way down the leg side, Steyn allows it through.
A sharp bouncer on off, Steyn ducks.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Digs in a bouncer around middle, Steyn sits underneath it.

Has hammered this one as well. Width on offer outside off, Dale throws his hands at it and drills it wide of mid off. The fielder there gets some fingertips onto it and it slows down before the rope. Two taken.
Full and angling in from outside off, Steyn drives it off the inner half to mid on.
FOUR! Smashing shot! Lakmal serves it on a length again, it's just outside off, Dale Steyn uses his reach and hammers it down the ground through mid off.
Edgy. Good length delivery close to off stump, straightening a bit, Steyn pushes inside the line and gets it away off the outer half to gully.
Works a length ball through square leg for a single.
In walks Dale Steyn. He can use the long handle. But his plan should be to give as much strike as possible to de Kock.

OUT! Straight down square leg's throat! A soft dismissal really. Fourth wicket for Fernando, his career-best bowling figures. A low full toss around leg, Rabada leans across to flick but fails to keep it down. It flies in the air and falls straight down Oshada's throat. Kagiso cannot believe his luck.
Wayward this time. Short and down the leg side, Rabada finds the line too wide to play at.
Bouncer around off at 130 kph, it's easily left by Rabada.
A little bit of width outside off, Rabada stays back to play it down towards cover-point.
Angles in a length ball on off, Rabada covers the line and blocks it from the crease.
Begins his spell with a short ball around off, de Kock mistimes his pull shot off the bottom half through square leg. One run added to the total.
Vishwa Fernando will also continue from the opposite end.
Nicely controlled shot. De Kock stands back to fetch a short ball from wide outside off and pulls it all along the carpet to deep mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Rabada flicks it in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Extra bounce from a length around middle, Kagiso is taken by surprise but he reacts well to keep it out safely on the off side.
The line is straight and de Kock eases it in front of square leg for an easy run this time.

Direct hit would have consumed Rabada! A length ball around leg, Kagiso helps it towards mid-wicket and crosses for a hesitant single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end otherwise he was short by a couple of yards.
Starts with a fuller length ball on middle, Rabada brings a straight bat down and defends it watchfully on the leg side.

All in readiness yet again. The overrate has bee abysmal today and there are still 42 overs left to be bowled. Looked unlikely even if they take an extra half an hour. Anyway, coming to the match situation, we can expect fireworks from Quinton de Kock with only three wickets left. Rabada will be on strike first up though. Suranga Lakmal to continue from this end. Let's play...
... DAY 1, THIRD SESSION ...

Sri Lanka are in a good position in this game but they can't relax, especially with Quinton de Kock out there. He is easily capable of adding some quick runs and get the hosts to a competitive total. The Islanders would not want that and they would look to wrap the innings up quickly. Join us in a short while for what could be another exciting session of cricket.

A decent session of Test cricket we witnessed here. It started off with Bavuma getting run out in a very unfortunate manner. Philander too did not contribute a lot with the bat. At 131 for 6, the hosts were in serious trouble. However, Maharaj and de Kock then joined hands and counter-attacked. The two added a handy 47-run stand before the former was dismissed.
Fullish on pad, Kagiso drives it to mid on and takes a run. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 1.
Same ball, Rabada ducks to save his head.
Bumper on body, the batsman ducks underneath it.
On middle, Rabada defends it onto the ground.
Fullish on leg, Rabada drives it uppishly towards mid on.
Short and on middle, de Kock pulls it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Short and on body, Rabada defends it to the leg side.
Bumper on middle, Rabada ducks under it. Lakmal looking to put pressure on him right on the first ball.
Around off, Quinton pulls it to mid-wicket and collects a single.
On stump line, the batsman has kept it out.
Fullish on middle, Quinton defends it back to the bowler.
Full toss on off, de Kock defends it off his front foot.
Kagiso Rabada is the new batsman in.

OUT!  A huge spike on Ultra Edge and Keshav Maharaj is given his marching orders. Also, a review goes down the drain. That review was more in hope I feel as this partnership was going great guns. However, a superb nut to end a very handy innings by Maharaj. Fernando lands it on a length around off, the ball pitches and straightens. Not a lot Maharaj could have done there. He lunges and looks to block but due to the away movement, the ball takes the outside edge and goes into the hands of the keeper. An appeal follows and the umpire agrees. Maharaj reviews and replays show that the on-field call was the right one. Sri Lanka will look to wrap it up now. Can they stop South Africa from crossing 200?
Have Sri Lanka got another? The umpire has given Maharaj out caught behind but he has reviewed.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, the batsman defends that one off his front foot.
Over the wicket lands it on middle, Maharaj leaves it alone as it was going away from him.
FOUR! Short and on leg, Maharaj hooks it uppishly to square leg and gets himself a boundary.
On middle, Maharaj defends it back to the bowler.
Vishwa Fernando is back into the attack.
Tossed up on off, Maharaj plays it towards covers for a run. Big over for South Africa. 10 runs came from it.
FOUR! Amazing shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Maharaj lofts this over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short delivery outside off, Quinton cuts it towards point for a single.
Floated on middle, Quinton defends off the back foot.
FOUR! Good shot. Short outside off, de Kock slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Floated on leg, de Kock flicks it towards the leg side for a run.
Short delivery again, Maharaj rises on his toes and defends it off the back foot.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Maharaj looks to pull but misses it.
Length delivery on leg, Keshav nudges it to the leg side. There was a confusion regarding the single. In the end they decide not to take the single.
Good length delivery on off, Maharaj looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully. It fell well short of the fielder.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Maharaj nudges it towards fine leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock slaps it through covers. The fielder chases it and stops it comfortably before the rope. The batsmen get three runs.
Short delivery again, Maharaj pulls it over mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Short outside off, Maharaj cuts it through point. Two runs taken.
Floated on middle, de Kock flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short outside off, Maharaj cuts it towards point for a run.
Flighted delivery on leg, Quinton looks to play a reverse sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Tossed up on middle, de Kock plays a reverse sweep towards point.
On the shorter side, Maharaj pushes it to covers.
A bumper on the body of the batsman, Maharaj somehow fends it away.
Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss, it is flicked through square leg for a single.
Down the leg side, de Kock looks to flick but misses.
Slash and a miss! Short and outside off, de Kock swings but misses.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Slightly fuller and coming in with the angle. De Kock stands tall and just smashes it past mid on. It races away to the fence.
Flighted delivery on middle, Maharaj defends off the back foot.
Short outside off, Maharaj makes room and cuts it past first slip towards third man. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up on middle, Maharaj looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes past the stumps and the keeper towards fine leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Floated on middle, Keshav keeps it out.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short and outside off, Maharaj cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle and leg, de Kock defends it towards short leg where the fielder looks to stop the ball but it goes past him. The batsmen take a run.
Third consecutive leave for Maharaj. Outside off, Keshav offers no shot.
Same delivery, Maharaj lets it go.
Outside off, Keshav leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on off, Maharaj keeps it out.
Full on middle, Quinton flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
NO BALL! Kasun Rajitha oversteps? Short outside off, de Kock cuts it towards point. Umpire gives no ball for overstepping but the replays show that he had some part of his foot behind the line.
Good length delivery on off, de Kock looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Loopy delivery on off, Keshav blocks it off his front foot.
Floated outside off, Maharaj cuts it to point.
Flighted delivery on off, Keshav blocks it well.
Floated on off, Maharaj keeps it out.
FOUR! Too short and outside off, Maharaj makes room and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Maharaj lets it go.
A little too straight, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
Keshav Maharaj is the new batsman in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Too quick that one for Philander! Kasun gets his second and Philander's resistance comes to an end. It is on the shorter side and around off, Philander goes back and tries to pull. The ball though skids through and hits the splice of Philander's bat even before he could complete the shot. It balloons towards the bowler who accepts a dolly. The umpires want to check for the front foot and it is just about fine.
On the off pole, Philander leans forward and keeps it out.
On the stumps, the batter goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Shortish and outside off, de Kock cuts it through point. There is a fielder in the deep so only a single.
Full on middle, Philander drives it to mid on.
Outside off, the batsman lets it go.
Tossed up on off, Philander plays it towards the off side.
Floated on off, Philander keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Philander looks to push but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up on middle, de Kock flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.

DRINKS! A decent hour for both the sides. The Lankans did manage to get the well-set Bavuma early but since then, Philander and de Kock have done well and are amidst a good stand. South Africa will hope the two continue whereas, the Lankans will hope to break this partnership as soon as possible.
Length delivery on middle, Philander pushes it to short mid-wicket.
On off, Philander defends off the front foot.
De Kock drives this full delivery towards mid off. The batsmen change ends.
Short outside off, de Kock cuts it to point.
Length delivery on leg, de Kock looks to flick but misses it.
Full on off, Quinton drives it to mid off.
BEATEN! Beautiful delivery. Tossed up outside off, Philander looks to defend but misses it due to the away turn on this one.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, de Kock nudges it towards the leg side for a run.
Floated on middle, Quinton pushes it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot. Flighted delivery on off, de Kock plays a reverse sweep towards third man for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Quinton defends off the front foot.
Short delivery, de Kock pulls it towards square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Lasith Embuldeniya is back.
Outside off, Philander shoulders his arms to this one.
Short and outside off, de Kock cuts it towards point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Quinton offers no shot.
De Kock drives this full delivery to covers.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock looks to cut but it hits the inner half.
On off, de Kock plays it back to the bowler.
Kasun Rajitha is back into the attack.
On off, de Kock plays it towards point and takes a quick single.
On off, Quinton keeps it out.
De Kock defends this good length delivery on the front foot.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Philander flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Philander defends this good length delivery on the front foot.
Length delivery on off, Philander defends it back towards the bowler.
Bowls it down the leg side, de Kock lets it go.
Philander cuts this short delivery towards point. The batsmen take a run.
The batsman defends this good length delivery on the front foot.
Philander defends it off the back foot.
The batsman cuts this short delivery towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
De Kock drives this fuller delivery to mid off.
On a good length  on off, Vernon defends off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Philander lets it go.
Length delivery outside off, de Kock cuts it towards point for a single.
Again on a good length on off, Quinton blocks it well.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock looks to chase this one but misses it.
Length delivery on leg, Philander tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Full again, de Kock strokes it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, de Kock cuts it through point for a couple.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On the shorter side, de Kock pulls it through square leg for a run.
Vernon Philander is the new batsman in.

OUT! Bavuma is short by just! End of his innings in a very unfortunate manner. He walks back dejected, three short of a half ton. A full delivery by Vishwa Fernando on middle, de Kock creams it back towards the bowler who was trying to move his feet out of the way. However while his left foot came down, it hits the ball and ends up deflecting it on the stumps at the non-striker's end. The Lankans are already celebrating and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show it is touch and go. In one frame it seems like Bavuma is in, the other shows that Bavuma is out. However, the third frame shows Bavuma's dive is not enough to save him. Both the set batsmen now back in the hut and the Lankans are now into the lower order.
Have Sri Lanka got another one in a fortunate manner? They are confident as a run out appeal at the non-striker's end has been taken upstairs.
Good length delivery on off, de Kock defends off the front foot.
Short outside off, Quinton cuts it through point for a single.
Full on off, Bavuma drives it through mid off for a run.
FOUR! Length delivery on off, Bavuma looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes between third and fourth slip towards third man for a boundary.
Outside off, Bavuma lets it go.
Bowls down the leg side, Bavuma looks to flick but misses it. A muted appeal for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head.
Outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to this one.
Full on middle, Quinton drives it to mid on.
Short outside off, Bavuma cuts it towards point for a single.
Length delivery on off, de Kock looks to defend but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards square leg for a run.
On off, Quinton defends off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock shoulders his arms to this one.
Full toss on middle, de Kock drives it to mid on. Quinton misses out on a boundary here.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On the shorter side, Bavuma blocks it out.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length around off, de Kock pushes it towards cover for a single.
On a length and around off, de Kock looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. It rolls towards point.

NOT OUT! It is off the elbow! De Kock survives to fight another day. Lakmal bowls a good length delivery and it lands around off. De Kock first thinks of playing at it but then at the end tries to leave. The ball goes off something low to the left of Dickwella. He dives and takes it, an appeal follows and the umpire raises the finger. De Kock reviews it straightaway. Time for the replays and they show that the on-field call has to overturned. The hosts will breath a huge sigh of relief as if de Kock would have fallen, the Lankans would have been into the lower-order.
De Kock has been given out caught behind. He though has reviewed. Looked off the glove but de Kock reviewing immediately might just mean it is off some other part.
Suranga Lakmal is on now.
Outside off, Temba leaves it alone.
Full on off, de Kock looks to drive but gets an inside edge. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen cross ends.

It was bowled on the shorter side where it pitched outside off and came back into the batsman. Bavuma looks to leave but gets a glove on the last moment. It goes towards Dickwella where it fell short of him. The batsmen take a quick run.
Full on off, Temba drives it through covers. Two runs taken.
Outside off, Bavuma lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to this one.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, the keeper-batsman shoulders his arms to this one.
Good length delivery on middle, de Kock keeps it out.
FOUR LEG BYES! Consecutive boundaries for Quinton. Length delivery on leg, de Kock looks to flick but gets it off his pads. It goes towards fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Good start after Lunch. Good length delivery outside off, de Kock looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes past the diving fourth slip fielder for a boundary.
We are back after Lunch. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Temba Bavuma is joined by Quinton de Kock in the middle. Kasun Rajitha will continue his over.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

South Africa were made to struggle at the start. They couldn't cope with the moving ball and lost their top order cheaply. Faf and Bavuma were looking good for the time they were there but a loose shot from the skipper means that they have lot of work ahead. Sri Lanka just need a wicket and then they will head into the lower order. It promises to be an entertaining second session. Join in after a short while.

Sri Lanka's meal would taste sweeter after Faf's wicket. Any team who wins the toss, inserts the opposition and takes 4 wickets before Lunch will be more than pleased. Lakmal and Fernando started it all for the visitors. They pegged the hosts back picking up 3 early wickets. Bavuma and Faf then started to get their side back in the game, stitching a 50-run stand but Rajitha struck just at the stroke of Lunch.

OUT! There is a spike on Ultra Edge and the on-field call has to be overturned. Now we know why Sri Lanka were so sure, excellent review by them and they have got the South African skipper. Also a timely one as this partnership was starting to look dangerous. It has been cut short in a soft manner though. A delivery down the leg side, Faf looks to flick, there is a noise as the ball passes the bat. The keeper takes and he starts celebrating, so does the bowler. Faf du Plessis however stands his ground. The umpire then shakes his head. Sri Lanka straightaway go for the review. Replays roll in and they show that there is bat involved. Faf has to take the long walk back after getting a start. Also, THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Review time! Sri Lanka feel they have Faf caught down the leg side. The umpire feels different. Sri Lanka have reviewed though. Big moment this.
On the 4th stump line, Faf comfortably defends that one onto the ground.
Or maybe play the paddle! Bavuma plays it nice and fine and picks up a couple.

Faf once again dances down the track but looks to drive, it goes off the inner half and towards long on for a run. This might be the way to go against the spinner, use you feet as he is tossing it up nicely and also bowling it slow.
FOUR! Up and over! Gets to the pitch this time and with a straight bat, lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Uses his feet but does not get to the pitch of the ball. Blocks it.
Similar length and line to the last one, not the same turn though. Faf this time goes back and works it to square leg.

Almost struck on his very first ball! What a delivery that is, it has just about missed the off stump and the outside edge. Just unplayable. Extremely slow and it is given good amount of air. Lands around middle and then turns square. Faf lunges and tries to keep it out but the ball rips past the outside edge and goes close past the off pole. Also, turn straightaway for the spinner.
Lasith Embuldeniya is into the attack. He is on debut.
On middle, the batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of delivery.
FOUR! Consecutive ones for Bavuma. Fullish on off, Temba drives it through covers and bags himself a one more.
FOUR! Short and on the body, Bavuma connects his hook and manages to clear the fence. A one bounce off the ropes.
Yorker length outside off, Bavuma leans in for the drive but misses.
On middle, Bavuma defends it towards cover.
Hurls it outside the off pole, Bavuma shoulders his arms to it.
A dot to end! This is on off, FdP strokes it to mid off. A good looking drive but for no runs.
Well bowled! Bowls it just behind a driving length and gets it to move away. Faf du Plessis looks to drive it on the up but is beaten. That was not quite there to drive.
Another couple! Runs coming thick and fast in this over. Short and outside off, Faf hits it through cover-point and takes two.
On the pads, this is tucked around the corner and takes a couple. There is swing on offer for Karunaratne but due to his pace, the batsman have a lot of time to adjust.
On the stumps, Bavuma plants his front foot ahead and then plays it nicely through mid on. The fielder from mid off hares after it and stops it with a slide. Saves a run for his side.
Gentle medium pace on the off stump, Bavuma is half-forward as he keeps it out.

FOUR! Around off, Faf looks to drive but due to the away movement of the ball, it takes an outside edge and runs down through backward point. A boundary results. The 50-run stand is up and a very vital one. They were 17-3 and the two are now trying to steady the ship. They have done well so far but need to continue.
Again on the same line, du Plessis watches it go back to the keeper.
Bouncer outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
On middle, Faf defends this one off his back foot.
FOUR! Classic Faf! It was on off, he drives it past cover. The fielder chases it but the ball still makes it to the ropes.
On the 4th stump line. Du Plessis looks to defend at it but misses.
A single to end another tight over by DK. On the shorter side, Faf goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
A little too straight and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Another one outside off and it is another leave.
A little bit of drift away from the batter but the line is outside off, left alone.
On the off pole now, Faf is solid in defense.
BEATEN! Extra bounce there for the bowler! Effort ball by Karunaratne. However, it is short and wide outside off. Faf looks to cut but is done in by the extra bounce.
FOUR! A well-controlled pull shot! Short and down the leg side, Bavuma just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence. Good end to the over for South Africa.
Second leave in a row as it is once again bowled outside off.
Outside off, Bavuma is in no mood to play at those.
Shortens his length this time and it is closer to the off pole, Bavuma gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Fullish and around off, Bavuma strokes it through covers nicely. It is not right off the middle but enough to get two. Also, Kasun has overstepped.
Outside off this time, Bavuma need not play at those.
On the fuller side, not a lot of movement visible now. Bavuma strokes it towards mid on.
A decent end to the over! On off again, Faf is solid in defense. Good tight start by the Lankan skipper.
Inside edge! This one comes back in after pitching. Faf looks to keep it out but it goes off the inside edge and hits the pads.
Just ahead of a length and outside off, Faf guides it to gully.
A single now! This is on middle, Bavuma plays inside the line, it goes off the inner half and through square leg for a single.
This is a little too wide outside off, the batsman lets it be. Not a very good second delivery.
On the off pole, Bavuma defends it nicely. Good start by the skipper.
Dimuth Karunaratne is on now.
Around off, du Plessis defends that one off the back foot.
Hurls it on leg, the batsman looks to flick it but fails to put bat on ball.
FOUR! 50 comes up for South Africa! The ball was on good length and going outside leg, Faf flicks it through square leg and gets a boundary.
Bouncer on 4th stump line, Faf leaves it alone.
Fullish and on leg, Faf flicks it to square leg.
Around off, the batsman offers a front foot defense to it.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Good length and on off, Bavuma goes at it with hard hands, it goes off the inner half towards mid on. The fielder at short mid-wicket runs to his left and stops a single.
FOUR! A little width on offer and Bavuma cashes on it. Short and wide outside off, Bavuma goes back and guides it through backward point. Boundary. Runs starting to come now for the hosts.
Well left! From around the wicket it is bowled slightly outside off, Bavuma covers his off pole and shoulders arms.
Back of a length on off, Bavuma pushes it to point.

Excellently bowled again! This is angled into the batsman first from around the wicket, it pitches and then moves away. Faf looks to defend but is squared up. The ball goes off the outer half and through backward point for a single.
It was on off, the batsman cuts it to point.
Good length and around off, Bavuma has played that one off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Second of the over. It was on off, Bavuma looks to defend but the ball comes off the bat's outside edge and  runs down through the legs of third slip .
Outside off, the batsman looks to defend but misses.
FOUR! On the pad, Bavuma flicks it through square leg and gets a boundary. Third boundary of the match.
Uneven bounce there and that has hurt Bavuma. Just ahead of a shorter length, Bavuma's weight is on the front foot but then the ball rises from nowhere. He tries to fend it but gets hit on the body.
Kasun Rajitha is on now. First change today.
On a length again, Bavuma gets right behind the line and defends it.
A little too straight, FdP works it towards fine leg for a single.
Another short delivery, this time though Faf was upto the task, he pulls it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Good change in length there! The bumper and it is a well-directed one. Faf ducks under it at the very end.
Good length and around off, Bavuma taps it towards cover and sets off for a run. They complete it with ease.
Good length again and it is shaping away with the angle, Bavuma shoulders arms to this one.
Faf leaves it alone as it was bowled wide off his stumps.
Bowls it wide on off, Faf leaves it alone.
Outside off, du Plessis looks to drive it but misses.

Good length and the ball shapes away from the batsman, Faf looks to play this one with soft hands. But the ball goes off his outside edge and to the first slip fielder. Lucky there for the batsman that it didn't carry to the fielder.
Bowls it on off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Back of a length and outside off, Faf swings at it with his foot muded on the crease. The ball takes a bottom edge and goes back to the bowler.

Drinks! It has been a good hour for Sri Lanka. They have taken three quick wickets and put pressure on the hosts. Vishwa Fernando was the pick of the bowlers as he picked two wickets. Lakmal got the solitary wicket of Hashim Amla. South African batsmen have lacked application and would like Faf du Plessis and Temba Bavuma to continue after the break.
In the 5th stump line, Faf pushes it to mid on and bags a single. They wanted a two but was fielded well.
On off, drives it to covers and takes a single.
Good length delivery and on off, the batsman cuts it to point.
On middle, Bavuma defends that one, getting right behind the ball.
Around off, Bavuma looks to defend but the ball takes an outside edge and it runs down to second slip.
Outside off, left alone by the batsman.
A single to end! On the shorter side, this is pushed towards cover and the batsmen cross ends. A testing over this.
Bavuma isn't looking certain here. Not sure on what to leave and what to play. Back of a length delivery on off, Bavuma first looks to leave it on a length but then at the very end, keeps it out.
Well bowled and well played! This begins on off and then it starts moving away. Bavuma looks to defend but since it starts shaping away early, he adjusts and makes a leave.
This is angled into the batsman, Faf du Plessis shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket. Takes a run.
A little bit of away movement but the delivery is outside off, Faf du Plessis leaves it alone.
Continues bowling it on a length and around off, Faf is half forward as he keeps it out.
Full delivery on off, Faf plays it towards covers for a run.
EDGE AND FOUR! Good length delivery on off, du Plessis looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes between second and third slip for a boundary.
Good length delivery again outside off, du Plessis lets it go.
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis blocks it well.
Good length delivery on off, the skipper looks to defend but due to the movement, he gets an outside edge towards third slip. It fell way short of the fielder.
Outside off, du Plessis offers no shot.
Again on a good length and outside off, Bavuma lets it go at the last moment.
Good length delivery outside off, Bavuma looks to defend but gets beaten by the away movement. It was close to the outside edge.
Length delivery on off, Temba keeps it out.
Outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to this one.
Again on a good length  on middle, Bavuma comes forward and looks to defend but it goes of the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Bavuma taps it to point.
On middle stump, Faf manages to turn it fine on the leg side for a couple of runs. Off the mark. 8 runs off this over but a wicket too from it.
Good ball first up to du Plessis! A length ball on middle and moving into the righty. Extra bounce and Faf does well to fend that on to the leg side by removing his bottom hand off the willow.
The new man in is Faf du Plessis.

OUT! Cleaned up!!! Markram has to go. What a beauty from Fernando after being hit for a boundary. Till now, Vishwa was taking most of the balls away. This one is on a good length and coming in to the right-hander. Markram is on the front foot and looks to drive the ball away to the on side. It shapes just enough to take the inside edge and disturb his stumps. Aiden is gone after looking decent so far. Sri Lanka will be really happy with the way things have gone so far after opting to bowl here.
FOUR! On a good length outside off, punched off the back foot for a boundary to deep cover-point.
Fuller length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Length ball outside off, pushed on the front foot to the right of mid off for a couple of runs by Markram. He has looked solid so far.
Left alone outside off to end a good over from Lakmal.
A good length ball on middle, Bavuma looks to defend but the ball takes the inner edge and runs to leg gully on the bounce.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through outside off.
Length ball outside off, defended from the crease by Temba.
Shorter one on the pads, worked away to deep square leg for a couple of runs by Bavuma. Off the mark straightaway.
Surprise, surprise... Temba Bavuma walks in at number 4. No sign of Faf... Looks like South Africa believe Temba is the crisis man.

OUT! Big wicket for Sri Lanka. Lakmal gets his wicket. Good length delivery on off, Amla looks to play at this one but decides to leave at the last moment. He was late in doing so and the ball takes a bottom edge and goes towards the slip cordon. Kusal Mendis at second slip dives forward and takes a good catch. The umpire wants to see if it is clean so takes it up. His soft signal is however, not out. Replays showed us that there is conclusive evidence and Amla starts walking immediately. Good catch from Mendis and Amla who was given a life before doesn't make the most of it. His poor form in this format continues.
Amla has nicked one! The catch has been taken in the slip cordon but the umpire has soft signalled it as not out. Does Amla have another life?
On off, Aiden keeps it out.
Good length delivery on middle, Markram blocks it well.
Length delivery on leg, Amla looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run. Umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Short and wide outside off, Amla looks to cut but gets beaten on this one.
Length delivery outside off, Amla cuts it to point.
Length delivery on off, Markram plays it through mid off for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Amla keeps it out.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Markram flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
On middle, Markram defends off the back foot.
Again on a good length and outside off, Aiden shoulders his arms to this one.
Length delivery on middle, Markram defends it to short mid-wicket.
Good shape on this one. Good length delivery outside off, Markram offers no shot.
Length ball on the pads, glanced away fine on the leg side for a single down to deep fine leg. Markram keeps strike.
Short of a length and on top of middle and off, defended from within the crease by AM.
Sprayed way down the leg side and moving further away, too far for Markram to make contact on that ball.
On a length and at the hips, worked away to deep square leg for three runs by Amla as he gets off the mark.

Leading edge... but safe. A length ball on leg stump and moving away slightly from the righty, Aiden closes the face of his bat too quickly and the ball goes off the leading edge and away from the bowler straight back down the ground. An easy single is taken in the end. Good bowling this from Vishwa.
Wide outside off, cut off the back foot but straight to the fielder at point. Markram would feel he missed out there.
On a good length  on off, Amla stands tall and defends off the back foot.
Outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to this one.
Length delivery on off, the batsman taps it towards point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Aiden looks to drive but gets beaten by the away movement on this one.
Again on a good length, Markram keeps it out.
Good length delivery on off, Markram defends off the back foot.

Confusion! Confusion! That's what happens when you have a new captain. Sri Lanka might have missed out on a huge wicket here. A length ball landing on middle and leg, going on straight with the line. Amla looks to defend but the ball misses his bat and he gets rapped on the pads in the line of the stumps. There is a huge appeal from the bowler and keeper but there is no reaction from the umpire. Looks really close and Dimuth Karunaratne consults his players before deciding to go upstairs. But by that time, it is too late. And to the Sri Lankan's dismay, the replays roll through and show us that the ball would have been hitting the off stump and 3 reds on the Ball Tracker. Huge opportunity missed here, out of all people, Amla is not the person you should be giving two chances to. Sri Lanka though, will be best served to put this out of their mind and concentrate ahead. We also later get information from the commentators on air that the maximum allowed time of 15 seconds might not have passed there, and for some unexplained reason the umpire did not take it upstairs that time. Whatever it is though, Sri Lanka have missed out here, nothing is going to go back and change the decision now.
Review time... Oh wait! The stipulated time of 15 seconds has passed and the review cannot be taken now by Sri Lanka.
Outside off and shaping away, left alone by Amla as he watches the ball all the way to the keeper's gloves.
Hashim Amla is in to bat at number 3.

OUT! This time he is a gonner! There is an edge and Aleem Dar's finger goes up immediately. Vishwa Fernando strikes. A length ball outside off and in the corridor of uncertainty, Dean Elgar looks to feel for the ball and defend it but the ball holds its line and he is playing down the wrong line. It takes the faintest of outside edges and carries to Dickwella who makes no mistake behind the stumps. A 4-ball duck for Elgar, and just the start Sri Lanka would have wanted after winning the toss and opting to bowl first. This should give them a lot of confidence.

Loud appeal but the experienced Aleem Dar does not flinch. Another really full one outside off, and shapes away at the last moment to beat the outside edge of Elgar who was looking to defend. There is a noise due to the bat hitting the ground as the ball passes and the keeper and slips go up in loud appeal but there was no edge there and its a good decision from the umpire.
Goes really full on the second ball outside off, Dean defends it off the bottom of his bat towards cover.
Good ball to start! A length ball and slightly shaping in after landing, Markram defends it to the on side awkwardly. His bottom hand comes off the bat as he completes his defense.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end and share the new ball.
A maiden to start off proceedings here. A good over from Lakmal ends with one on a shorter length just outside off and Markram defends watchfully.
It has become overcast all of a sudden, the Sun was out a little while back.
On a length outside off, defended on the back foot by AM.
Outside off and shaping away, left alone by the batsman.

Confusion! But all is okay in the end. Lakmal pushes this one a little full on off and Markram leans into the on drive. Looks for a single but his partner is ball watching. The mid on fielder though, has to make a tumbling stop and cannot get to the ball in time. Aiden makes it back to his crease safely.
Another ball on the money just outside off and on a good length, kept out solidly by Markram.
Starts off with one on good length and on off stump line, defended watchfully towards the square leg fielder by Aiden.

The Sri Lankan eleven, the South African openers and the umpires walk to the middle to start off this game. Dean Elgar and Aiden Markram the usual suspects at the top for the hosts. Suranga Lakmal, the most experienced bowler for SL with the new ball for the tourists. Three slips in place to start off with for Markram. Let's play...
The two teams are out in the middle for their respective national anthems. We begin with the visitors' anthem first up...
Team news - Keshav Maharaj and Faf du Plessis are back in the playing XI for the hosts.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win an important toss and opt to bowl first.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the Sri Lankan tour of South Africa. The Islanders have been on the road for three big away tours now. They failed to impress on their previous series and now travel to South Africa. Their history here doesn't look a good reading and they will need something special to get the better of the hosts. The team from the sub-continent will have a new leader in Dimuth Karunaratne and the Lions will hope he can do something special. The Proteas on the other hand, play the first Test in Durban where their record on this venue is something they would not like to look at. Faf du Plessis will return to the XI and their pace bowling does not need any introduction. Let's hope there is something in it for everyone and also the weather doesn't play spoil sport.
